messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2025-06-06 the Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run. [valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, having moved from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2026-05-19, the job scheduler's leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2026-01-30 the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- On 2026-06-04 the Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings Cinder instead of the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-05-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-14]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- On 2026-04-08 the Atlas team noticed that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2026-04-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
- On 2025-03-26 the Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- On 2025-11-04 the Ember team saw that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-04]
- On 2025-12-25 the Atlas team noticed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- On 2025-12-31 the Atlas team noticed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- On 2026-04-16 the Atlas team noticed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2025-12-18 the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every product catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan. [decision; valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]
